description: This source file implements asynchronous service functions for managing tasks within a project management platform. It includes functionalities such as listing, creating, updating, changing status, assigning, and deleting tasks, with access control and activity recording.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Ensures that a user is a member of a project and returns the project object.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Returns a list of non-archived tasks for a project if the user has access.

methods.name: Task create_task( db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str], status_value: str, priority_value: str, due_date=None, assignee_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new task in a project, validating user and assignee permissions, and records activity.

methods.name: Task update_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, updates: dict)
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing task, with permission checks and activity recording.

methods.name: Task change_status(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, status_value: str)
methods.description: Changes the status of a task and records the change as activity.

methods.name: Task assign_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, assignee_id: int | None)
methods.description: Assigns or unassigns a task to a project member, with activity logging.

methods.name: None delete_task(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes (soft or hard) a task from a project ensuring user permissions and logs activity.
